title: Fragmented RPL DIO bypasses authenticated DODAG admission
description: python/src/lichen/node.py only classifies and calls DodagState.process_authenticated_dio() in the unfragmented SCHC branch (lines 832-846). After authenticated SCHC reassembly, the fragment branch proceeds directly to generic IPv6 routing/delivery, so an otherwise valid DIO that exceeds the single-frame ceiling can never install its peer SCHC policy or join/update the DODAG. The generic path may instead deliver/route it as data. Extend the LinkLayer/Node reassembly contract so a fully authenticated fragmented DIO is admitted through the same one-use authenticated DIO validation and policy commit, with tests for valid and malformed fragmented DIOs.
